title: GA4 sessions and users per project

metrics.name: ga.sessions_1d
metrics.label: sessions/day
metrics.means: GA4 sessions for the last complete UTC day, per property, attributed to a project either by the mapping file's explicit project id or by the property's declared host through plugins/hostmap.py.

metrics.name: ga.users_1d
metrics.label: users/day
metrics.means: GA4 active users for the same day and property. Kept beside Cloudflare's uniques deliberately: the two disagree by design (JS consent vs edge counting), and the gap between them is itself a signal about consent rates and blockers.

why: Measure sessions and active users for explicitly mapped Google Analytics properties. Private ga4_properties.json configuration connects each property to a host or project; missing mappings produce no invented measurements.
